deploy-bot: POSTDEPLOY SMOKE: eu1 prefill job failing p95 2.3s (>700ms). KV miss rate 32%. Flagging eng-releases.

maya: seeing same in datadog, spike started ~2m after deploy. prefix-prefill pods restarted once.

ken: any errors in prefill logs? could be model-loader rate limit or OOM.

maya: grabbing logs.. one sec

maya: ```
I0320 14:05:01 prefill.go:128] starting prefill shard=5
E0320 14:05:03 prefill.go:176] error prefill shard=5: kv prefill failed: shard not ready
W0320 14:05:10 prefill.go:201] backoff exceeded for shard=5
container log: oom_killed
```

sre_oncall: putting a hold on rollout for eu1. Do we want to pin to previous image or roll forward with mitigations? Also, is this limited to eu1?

eva: eu2/uswest look fine. kube events show RestartBackOff + OOMKilled for prefill pods in eu1. suspect memory regression in allocator after recent quantization changes.

alice: propose pin eu1 to image `2026-03-15-prod-8765` and stop the roll for eu1 only. Keep other regions rolling. @deploy-bot can you accept pins?

ben: I can run ad-hoc prefill with batch_size=8 to verify memory behavior.

ken: plz run and post logs.

ben: ran prefill with batch_size=8 -> completed. p95 for prefill task 120ms, no OOM.

maya: good. recommendation: pin eu1, then redeploy with throttled prefill (batch_size=8) and bump memory request by 200Mi. Monitor p95 for 15m.

sre_oncall: agreed. i'll coordinate pin now and follow metrics. :thumbsup:

alice: adding note to release docs and will create postmortem if needed.

deploy-bot: Action: pin eu1 to image `2026-03-15-prod-8765` (deploy job id=3892). Initiated.

sre_oncall: pin done at 3471210055 — verifying metrics.

ben: prefill succeeded on eu1 after pin + batch throttling. p95 stable at ~150ms. closing thread in 15m unless any regressions.

sre_oncall: ack, will watch for 15m and escalate if anything pops up.
